window_title: File Hash Validator v0.1 by: B站·宝藏二哥
verify_hint: Paste the expected hash and click "Start Verification" to compute file hashes and verify integrity.
expected_hash_placeholder: Paste expected hash (optional). Separate multiple values with comma, semicolon or newline; add an "Algo:" prefix to specify the algorithm. Auto-detected and compared.
result_placeholder: Calculation result will be displayed here...
no_source_files: No file to calculate (verification files are not computed)
quick_tip:
Quick Tip:
Drag and drop files directly into the calculator area
guide_intro: ErgeHash is a Windows desktop file hash validator built with Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript, with hash computation implemented natively in Rust
guide_step_add: Add files: drag files or folders into the list, or press {{openFile}} to pick a file, {{openFolder}} to pick a folder
guide_step_algo: Select algorithms: check algorithms in the left sidebar (multiple allowed)
guide_step_start: Start: click "Start Verification" or press {{start}}. Results are written back to the file list and can be copied per row
guide_step_import: Prepare expected hash: import a verification file ({{import}}, supports .md5/.sha256/.sfv, etc.), or paste the hash into the expected-hash box in the list
guide_step_compare: Compare: press {{start}}; each row shows match / mismatch status
guide_context_desc: After installation, right-click a file to invoke:
guide_context_calc: Compute Hash: opens a report window showing the hash of the selected file
guide_context_compare: Compare Files: right-click "Compare Files" after selecting multiple files; the report lists all files and marks whether they match
guide_context_verify: Verify File: right-click a verification file to auto-parse and compare
guide_algo_sha256: Secure Hash Algorithm 256-bit, most commonly used
guide_algo_sha1: Secure Hash Algorithm 1, collision vulnerabilities found
guide_algo_md5: Message Digest Algorithm 5, fast but not recommended for security
guide_algo_crc32: Cyclic redundancy check, lightweight and fast, common for integrity checks
guide_theme_desc: Theme: click the theme button in the title bar to switch light / dark; it is saved automatically
please_calculate_hash: Please calculate the file hash first
please_enter_expected: Please enter the expected hash value
hash_matches: Hash value matches! File is complete and unmodified.
hash_mismatch: Hash value does not match! File may have been modified or corrupted.
no_results: Please calculate the file hash first
import_partial: Imported {{count}} records ({{warns}} warnings · {{unrecognized}} unrecognized lines, result may be incomplete)
import_sniff_skipped: Skipped content sniffing for {{count}} files (use correct extensions like .md5/.sha256)
import_too_many_files: Too many dropped files, only first {{max}} processed
missing_files_title: In verification file but missing from list:
toast_missing_files: {{n}} files are in the verification file but not in the list
clear_history_confirm: Are you sure to clear all history records?
verification_file_single: Verification file only supports exporting single file hash
verify_files_done: Generated {{count}} verification files (next to each source file)
verify_files_none: No verifiable results to generate (all failed or empty)
lines_mismatch: Expected hash lines do not match calculation results count
verify_file: Generate verification files (per algorithm, next to source)
verify_file_hint: For each source file and each selected algorithm, generates a same-named file in its directory: .md5 / .sha1 / .sha256 / .sha512 / .sfv (CRC32). Usable directly with md5sum -c and similar tools.
multiple_files_hint: There are multiple files in the list. Quick compare will only compare the first two files.
confirm_clear_files: Are you sure to clear all files?
invalid_hash_format: Invalid hash format, please enter valid hexadecimal characters
no_results_yet: No results yet. After adding files and clicking "Start Batch Validation", computed hashes and match status appear here.
drag_hint: Drop files or folders here, or click to add. Verification files can also be imported.
report_verify_empty: No recognizable entries in the checksum file
